title: Oscar predictions are on as voting for awards starts
summary: The Golden Globes crowned One Battle After Another and Hamnet as best films in their categories, Timothee Chalamet and Jessie Buckley as best actor and actress. And now, the bets are on for the Oscars, held in March. With the Golden Globes are a predictor for Hollywood's most prestigious awards ceremony, FRANCE 24's Emma Jones takes a look at who the favour…
